To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the high-order dynamics of the integrator have a significant impact on the modulator characteristics.

the integrator settling time constant is a very important parameter in the design of a switched-capacitor sigma-delta modulators, and that the integrator frequency domain characteristics are very important to predict the sigma-delta moduator performance.

the integrator settling dynamics can affect even significantly the modulator performances and that a careful behavioral analysis based upon the proposed strategy is necessary to achieve the desired modulator performances avoiding costly transistorlevel parameters tuning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the effect of the integrators settling behavior on SigmaDeltaM performances, and it is focused on the identification of a behavioral simulation methodology that is able to provide a reliable and accurate description of the real modulator characteristics.
the effect of the integrators settling time behavior on the performances and design of SC SigmaDeltaM.
the study of the effects of the integrator dynamics on SigmaDeltaM performances and the definition of an effective design strategy to achieve the desired modulator performances.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integrator settling time should be carefully designed to achieve the best trade-off between the overall modulator performances and its power consumption.
a careful behavioral integrator modeling should be performed before any transistor-level design in order to avoid time consuming and costly transistor-level parameters optimization.
a behavioral simulation based on the proposed generic integrator model is necessary to obtain reliable early-design results and to avoid time-consuming transistor-level simulations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

behavioral analysis of SigmaDeltaMs should be performed by means of generic integrator models, which are able to take into account high-order integrator settling dynamics, in order to obtain more accurate design guidelines.
behavioral simulations based on a high-order integrator settling model allow to obtain accurate and reliable early-design guidelines for the integrator, and therefore, for the whole SigmaDeltaM.
a careful behavioral analysis is necessary in order to carryout a transistor-level design of SigmaDeltaMs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integrator dynamics should be considered as an important factor to be carefully taken into account when the SigmaDeltaM design is performed.
the integrator settling model has to take into account high-order dynamics to be used in the behavioral simulations of the SigmaDeltaM.
behavioral simulation is an effective tool to identify the integrator specifications for the desired modulator performances, and it can be used in the early design phase of a SigmaDeltaM.
